propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the patchset tree but the workflow definition comes from main, causing hard failures on changes branched before the file landed
Changes that predate the gate merge but run against the new workflow definition fail Verified with missing file error regardless of content, affecting all in-flight pre-gate changes
The gate must treat an absent floor file as skip-with-log rather than hard error, re-enforcing on rebase and post-merge, per the documented ee2a tree-skew guard convention
An under-floor git version must still fail with diagnostic naming required version, installed version, and upgrade path, preserving 980d enforcement for present floor files
The missing-file failure message must name the real cause (change predates gate) and remedy (rebase or post-merge) rather than just the filename
